extracted.intended_audience: researchers, businesses, research organisations and the wider public seeking information about UKRI funding, support and engagement
extracted.subtask_short: UKRI funding priorities and support areas
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level summary of the areas UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) invests in and the kinds of support it provides to researchers, businesses, institutions and the public. Useful for prospective applicants and stakeholders who want to align proposals or activities with UKRI priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment and support for researchers and businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide investment and support for researchers and businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the overarching purpose: UKRI invests in research and innovation, providing funding and support mechanisms aimed at both individual researchers and businesses to develop research and translate it into impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing people and skills
rubrics_metrics.description: We help our researchers develop new skills, enabling them to further their careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes support at every career stage (for example Future Leaders Fellowships). Emphasises training, career development and skills-building as funding priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration and engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: We enable collaboration and engagement across and beyond our communities, involving the wider public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UKRI supports team-up activities across disciplines, institutions and with external partners; encourages involving the public and non-academic stakeholders in research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing world-class infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: We improve the capabilities across the research system, within the UK and internationally, developing world-class infrastructure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers investment in facilities, equipment and capability to support high-quality research (see 'Infrastructure' overview). Proposals that strengthen or leverage infrastructure capacity are within scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting an inclusive and ethical research culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting an inclusive and ethical research culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises research integrity and the promotion of equality, diversity and inclusion across the research system; projects and institutions are expected to align with these cultural standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research commercialisation
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out how we help researchers, businesses and investors transform research into market-ready products and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority for activities that enable translation, spin-outs, partnerships with industry, and pathways to market for research outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about funding decisions (What we've funded)
rubrics_metrics.description: Help make your application more competitive with information about funding decisions and awarded grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UKRI publishes information on past awards to inform applicants about successful types of projects and to improve competitiveness of future applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: How we engage (modes of engagement)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ways we engage with our community and beyond, and how you can get involved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers consultation, stakeholder engagement, public activities and opportunities for researchers and organisations to participate in UKRI activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Browse information and resources on public participation and engagement in research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports projects that involve public participation, outreach and civic engagement; resources and guidance are provided for schools, students and general audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional investment across the UK
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how we support places and regions throughout England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UKRI invests to enable regional development and to ensure research and innovation support is distributed across the nations and regions of the UK.

rubrics_metrics.name: International funding and support
rubrics_metrics.description: How we fund and support collaborative research across the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports international collaboration and partnerships; funding mechanisms and programmes exist for cross-border research activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research financial sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: How UKRI is working to understand and support the financial sustainability of the sector.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on the long-term financial health of research organisations and the sector overall; policy work and funding approaches intended to enhance institutional and sector resilience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teaching resources and school engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and activities for schools and students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UKRI provides educational resources and activities targeted at schools and young people to foster engagement with research and STEM learning.
